I, Mrs. Subagini Mathiyalagan, Divisional Secretary of the Valikamam South West, Sandilipay in the Jaffna District in terms of Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) hereby give notice that, a sum of Rupees Four Hundred Eighty Thousand Six Hundred and Fifty Eight (Rs. 480,658.00) being compensation and sum of Rupees Five Hundred Eighty Four Thousand Three Hundred Fifty Five and Two cents (Rs. 584,355.02) for the acquisition of the land for National Housing Development Authority, described in the schedule below has been deposited under the case of the District Court of Mallakam, to be drawn by the person entitled thereto. Subagini Mathiyalagan, Divisional Secretary, Valikamam South West.Divisional Secretariat,Valikamam South West,Sandilipay,12th August, 2024.
